newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian official reserves rise in December.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian official reserves rise in December.

text.p: Australia's holdings of gold and foreign exchange assets rose to US$17.451 billion in December from US$16.292 billion in November, compared with US$14.950 billion in December 1995, the Reserve Bank of Australia said.
In Australian dollar terms, reserves rose by A$1.813 billion to A$21.909 billion in December from A$20.096 billion in November, compared with A$20.068 billion a year earlier, the bank said.
The RBA said the December rise, in Australian dollar terms, was mainly due to purchases of foreign exchange, including swap agreements for the purposes of domestic liquidity management.
